description.zh: 写作、发布，也留住值得记录的想法。由 WordPress 迁移而来的博客平台。

subject.en: Broad-winged faceted firefly with a small campfire
subject.zh: 展开双翼的切面萤火虫，与一小簇篝火

title.zh: 展翼，也留出呼吸的空间

description.en: The broad-winged firefly leads the mark. A small fire below its gaze supplies the second point of interest, with clear space around the complete silhouette.
description.zh: 舒展双翼的萤火虫占据主体，视线下方的小篝火形成第二处兴趣点。完整的轮廓四周留出空间，让翅尖远离圆角边缘。

title.zh: 切面的萤光，立体的火焰

description.en: Connected champagne, bronze, and gold planes describe the insect. Two visible eyes give its gaze direction; curved flame and wood grain add tactile depth to the small campfire.
description.zh: 香槟色、青铜色与金色的连续切面构成萤火虫，两只清楚的眼睛交代视线。弯曲的火焰与木纹为小篝火增添立体质感。

description.en: A deep blue-green field carries a quiet crescent, sparse stars, and cloud contours. Warm light around the flame and abdomen lifts the mark from the matte night surface.
description.zh: 深蓝绿色底面上浮现安静的月牙、疏星与云纹。火焰和尾部的暖光，让主体从哑光的夜色中轻轻浮起。

sizeNote.en: At 24–32 px, the broad wings, amber abdomen, and small fire carry the identity. At 16 px, eyes, fine legs, and wood grain simplify into the warm silhouette.
sizeNote.zh: 在 24–32 px 下，展开的翅膀、琥珀色尾部与小篝火承担辨识度。缩到 16 px 时，眼睛、细腿与木纹会合并进暖色轮廓。

goal.en: Write, publish and organize a personal blog through a web console and AI clients sharing the same content.
goal.zh: 写作、发布和整理个人博客，让网页后台与 AI 客户端共用一套内容。

role.en: Blog, admin console and server APIs
role.zh: 博客、后台与服务端 API

role.en: Image storage through the S3 API
role.zh: 通过 S3 API 存储图片
经过 OAuth 授权的写作工具
依赖、脚本与测试运行器

description.en: An off-center crescent, sparse stars and broad cloud contours leave a quiet sky around the firefly.
description.zh: 偏心月牙、零星星光与舒展的流云，在萤火虫周围留出安静的夜空。

caption.en: A small light, a lasting story.

description.en: Broad-winged faceted firefly with a small campfire.
description.zh: 展开双翼的切面萤火虫，与一小簇篝火。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥62px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 62px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
